notes: Install update now works: every release is signed with one project key, so Android no longer ends the in-app update with App not installed.
Signing in on a fresh install lands on the dashboard, instead of waiting for a restart
A download that stops early now says so and resumes, instead of leaving an APK that can never install
Sellers who cannot produce a 3D file can ask the CUFMAI team to model the pair — measure the outside of the shoe and the team does the rest
The ask lands in the team's queue, only a model that is live on that product can close it, and both endings reach the seller in the team's own words
